methodology.timing_scope: LIGHT_HOST is actual CPU region lighting elapsed excluding synchronous consume/encoding callbacks. It is not in the scaled ASSEMBLY..COMPRESS worker range and is not process CPU time or utilization. On Metal it is lighting host time, not the CPU lighting kernel.
methodology.limits: Small-sample p95 and exhaustive paired bootstrap intervals are descriptive. Native completion excludes Java activation, rendering, packets and FPS. Source-level Vec removal is not measured allocator/DRAM/RSS savings.
